title: Managed Backup: price priority
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines price priority.

## Tier basis

**Price selection priority.** Non-stacking selection order for primary-usage price; string list.

| Contract tier | Price selection priority |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | Negotiated; Reservation; Promotion; Portfolio; Standard |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | Negotiated; Reservation; Promotion; Portfolio; Standard |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | Negotiated; Reservation; Promotion; Portfolio; Standard |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | Negotiated; Reservation; Promotion; Portfolio; Standard |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | Negotiated; Reservation; Promotion; Portfolio; Standard |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | Negotiated; Reservation; Promotion; Portfolio; Standard |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, price selection priority is Negotiated; Reservation; Promotion; Portfolio; Standard.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, price selection priority stays the same.
